Open-Source Project Brings Full iOS 27 Virtualization to Apple Silicon
items.blurb: The open-Source project vphone-cli enables a full iOS 27 system to run as a virtual machine on Apple Silicon.

items.title: One Decade of Rustls: Evolution, Benchmarks, and Future Roadmap
items.blurb: Rustls, a Rust TLS library, marks its decade-long progression from a grassroots project to a funded open-source initiative.

items.title: Article: When Spec-Driven Development Pays Off
items.blurb: AI coding assistants have become a core part of software development. AI-generated code has shown productivity gains, but it's also contributing to security weaknesses and familiar bug patterns.

items.title: Meta's Recipe for Building Agents as "Organizational Second Brains"
items.blurb: Meta describes how an AI agent can be designed to capture the logic and expertise of domain experts, rather than simply storing documents or retrieving relevant information.

items.title: The gpg.fail aftermath: On responsible disclosure, GPG, and the state of security in 2026 [32:37]
items.blurb: slides In 2025, I [the speaker] found and disclosed a bunch of vulnerabilities in GPG, the most used PGP implementation, and held a talk at 39c3 about it. Some of the bugs ended up getting fixed.
